items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: The Gabriel Brothers and their father are up there.

ctx.x: They have two units. They're using a small unit and a large unit. Tommy Saunders is playing trumpet with him sometimes. And Tommy's a wonderful player. And there's some awfully good musicians in the Detroit area too, so I imagine that they can put together some very fine bands. Yeah.
The Gabriel Brothers and their father are up there. Different ones, different New Orleans musicians are up around there too.
I guess the best all around multi-instrumentalist I ever met in my life was from Detroit, went to Wayne State University, Billy Prince. What's his name?
